fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Refuge capacity for cyclists and pushchair users at A4019 junction crossings serving a bus stop is a substantive Stage 1 VRU safety issue, not vacuous.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim (refuge width adequacy) is anchored by a verbatim quoted passage EV-UK-015 describing cyclists being clipped at narrow refuges; the bus-stop demand extension is flagged as assumption rather than invented fact.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a Stage 1 safety concern with null normative basis, keeping the safety question categorically distinct from any compliance assertion under GG 119.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: identifies each A4019 crossing point adjacent the bus stop and names the users (expectant parent with pushchair, cycle) whose accommodation drives required depth/width.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly addressed, with pushchair/cycle accommodation carried into the recommendation, so VRU impacts are fully considered.

justifications.substance: Verifying that existing large-vehicle swept-path envelopes remain valid after stop-line repositioning is a substantive Stage 1 check, especially given the cited analysis already shows limited over-run into opposing lanes.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim that swept-path analysis exists for the 7.5t box van and refuse vehicle is supported by the verbatim EV-UK-002 quote, and the stop-line repositioning is presented as a recorded input fact rather than invented content.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a compliance_question seeking confirmation rather than asserting a safety problem, with the GG 119 basis noted as an analog and no conflation of compliance and safety categories.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and actionable: re-run swept-path analysis over the as-adjusted stop-line positions before Stage 2, giving a clear deliverable and deadline.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists, central refuges, and desire lines are explicitly acknowledged as recorded context, but the finding scopes out any VRU-specific exposure assertion, so partial credit applies.
